title: People and device pairing
lead: Implement people, device pairing, the long-lived cookie, and revocation (ADR 0010, requirement U7).
boundary: **Not in this slice:** multi-household accounts, passwords, OAuth.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Unpaired devices must not use larder. A non-technical household member must never see a login screen after pairing. Requirement `added_by` attribution needs a Person.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body: Anything left unresolved by the pairing interview.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Generate tokens with `secrets`; store SHA-256 hashes; compare in constant time.
2. Implement the bootstrap flow as decided.
3. Pairing: admin creates a pairing link (QR rendered as decided). Opening it sets the device cookie bound to a Person.
4. A `before_request` guard maps the cookie to a device and person; it updates `last_seen` (throttled).
5. Admin devices page: list, rename, revoke.
6. Add CSRF tokens for forms (stdlib `secrets` + session).
7. Set `Secure` when the request scheme is https (via the trusted proxy).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- Auth tests pass.
- Manual run: pair a desktop browser, revoke it, and see the unpaired page.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
